input: Shadow a midwife for my doula certification hours

gold.taskTitle: Shadow a Midwife for Doula Certification Hours
gold.taskDescription: Arrange and complete midwife shadowing hours to fulfill a doula certification program requirement.

questions.title: Which doula certification program are you enrolled in?
questions.description: Identify the certifying organization (e.g., DONA, CAPPA, Birthing From Within) to understand specific shadowing requirements.

questions.title: How many shadowing hours does your program require?
questions.description: Determine the exact number of hours needed so the plan can be scoped correctly.

questions.title: Do you already have a midwife contact willing to host you?
questions.description: Establish whether outreach to find a midwife is needed or if a placement is already arranged.

questions.title: What is your deadline for completing these hours?
questions.description: Identify the certification submission date or exam date to set a realistic timeline.

questions.title: Are you open to hospital, birth center, or home birth settings?
questions.description: Clarify which birth settings are acceptable or preferred for the shadowing experience.

questions.title: What is your weekly availability for shadowing shifts?
questions.description: Understand scheduling constraints such as work, family, or other commitments to plan around.

questions.title: Does your program require specific documentation or supervisor sign-off?
questions.description: Determine what paperwork, forms, or verification the certifying body requires from the supervising midwife.
